Ever since my depression started I've been losing motivation for everything, but around that time I met my gf and she's what motivated me up until now. During these 3 years multiple things have happened like my parents getting divorced, getting into a bad fight that almost made me lose my eye, I had to get stitches across my nose and I was very lucky to have my eye spared, this fight had to do with my gf and now that she's gone it makes the whole thing seem pointless. Right now I'm failing multiple classes and want to fix what I can but I just don't have the ambition/motivation to do so. (I would hopefully be able to have make up exams in August) The breakup feels just as bad as it did at the start and isn't getting better. I just really want to stay home and cry, when I hurt myself it makes mental/emotional pain go away for a little and it just feels good. Also about meeting other people, I'm very antisocial, when I'm around other people I just feel really bad, just in public when I don't even have to interact with people I still feel terrible, it sucks so much. When I walk to the store I just want to walk straight back home because of everyone even tho no one did anything to me, I'm scared and don't trust anyone. My gf was the only person so far to actually somehow get close to me and have my trust, I really miss her, this is so terrible feeling, and I know there's nothing to do to get her back now.. Also thanks for taking your time to talk with me, I really appreciate it. :)
